⚡ Port Wait Time Analysis

Ports normalized (terminal suffixes merged). Bunkering-only calls excluded. Berth Rate = calls with wait < threshold / total calls (CNSHA & CNNGB < 12h, others < 6h; always based on all calls in time range). Ranked best→worst by default.

⏱ Over-range:

⚡ Wait by Port Region

Port wait aggregated by region (Port→Region per mapping). Over (range) follows the over-range selector above. Shows Calls / Total Wait / Avg Wait / Over / Over rate.

📊 Port Call Count by Lane

Count of port calls per lane, grouped by trade (Lane→Trade mapping). Follows Port Wait date/port/remark filters.

📊 Port Call Count by Region

Count of port calls per port, grouped by region (Port→Region mapping). Follows Port Wait date/port/remark filters.

📊 Wait Time by Remark Category

Category breakdown of port wait within selected filters and time range.

📈 Monthly Port Wait Trend

Monthly aggregation of port wait data within the selected time range and filters.

📊 BOA Berth-On-Arrival Stats

Source: CUL Daily Movement (follows Port Wait date range above) · Berth = WAIT ≤ threshold (CNSHA & CNNGB 12h, others 6h) · Lane→Trade / Port→Region per “Port & Lane Mapping”. Over-range options: All over = WAIT > threshold; 24h+ = WAIT ≥24h; 48h+ = WAIT ≥48h. Only the over count changes with range; berth count is unchanged.

💨 Vessel Speed Analysis

Speed values from source Excel column "SPEED" (calculated as leg distance ÷ sailing time). Min/Max = extreme values per vessel; values ≤0 or >20kn excluded as dirty data. Hover values to see raw source.

📊 Per-Port Maintenance Rate 每个港口 Port Log / Vessel Schedule 维护率（当前筛选下，点表头可排序）

Port Log Rate = 已维护 Port Log 的 calls ÷ 该港总 calls；Vessel Sched Rate = Maintain timely 的 calls ÷ 该港总 calls。绿 ≥80%，橙 ≥50%，红 <50%。

📍 Maintenance by Port

Click a port row to expand all calls for that port, each with its Port Log (Y/N) and Vessel Schedule (Maintain timely / Not maintained) status. Red = not maintained.

🔴 Port Log 未维护明细 — Port Log Y/N = N 的船期（未维护 Port Log）

🔴 Vessel Schedule 未维护明细 — Vessel Schedule Maintain Status = Not maintained 的船期（未维护船期）

📈 Monthly Maintenance Trend

📄 Export Tables to Excel

勾选需要导出的表；未勾选的不导出。所有勾选的表将写入同一个 Excel 文件（每张表一个工作表）。导出内容反映当前筛选 / 列可见性。

⇄ Lane Display Order

调整列表中 lane 的上下顺序，Full Schedule 即按此顺序展示。点击 ▲/▼ 移动，顺序自动保存（刷新后保留）。
